title: ipvs mode deprecated

detection.reason: read from the kube-proxy ConfigMap's own mode field; a mode passed only as a --proxy-mode container arg is not read here

quote: Marked `ipvs` mode in kube-proxy as deprecated, which will be removed in a future version of Kubernetes. Users are encouraged to migrate to `nftables`.
remediation: Plan the move to `nftables` (GA since 1.33) on nodes with a recent enough kernel, or to `iptables` on older ones. Nothing breaks at 1.35 — this is the deprecation, and the removal comes later — but the migration is a data-plane change worth doing outside an upgrade window.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get cm -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | (.data // {}) | to_entries[] | .value | scan("(?m)^ *mode: *\"?([a-z]+)") | .[0]'  # prints the configured kube-proxy mode; ipvs is deprecated from 1.35
